original_test_intent.statement: Repeatedly upload and delete a bounded test object through the approved BMC interface at 40 C/-5% rails, verifying transfer integrity and BMC/SEL health.
must_preserve: BMC data upload/removal cycle, high-temperature undervoltage condition and repeated operation.
unknowns: Interface/protocol, destination, file content/size/hash, repetitions or 30-minute interpretation, free-space reserve and acceptance thresholds.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It correctly prohibits arbitrary writes but uses BLOCKED for provisionable procedure inputs; the physical fixture makes the enduring class MANUAL ONLY.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: No file operation is ready. After owner defines a sandboxed transfer cycle, software steps may be automated, but operator-controlled margin makes the full test MANUAL ONLY.

revision_candidate.test_name: Cycle BMC Test-File Upload and Removal at 40 C and -5% Rails
revision_candidate.purpose: Exercise the approved BMC transfer/storage path for one owner-selected finite cycle count or 30-minute campaign under physical margin, verifying every object's integrity through an owner-approved end-to-end method, exact deletion, continuous capacity reserve and management health.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact BMC firmware/interface/storage partition in calibrated 40 C and owner-named -5% 5 V/3.3 V rail conditions, with signed control/measurement points, tolerances, soak and restoration sequence.
revision_candidate.target_scope: One canonical owner-created sandbox root and one uniquely named non-sensitive object per cycle; containment is revalidated before each delete. Never firmware partitions, configuration, logs, certificates, symlink/reparse escapes or arbitrary BMC paths.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Supported interface/commands; canonical sandbox identity and containment check; non-sensitive file size/hash and immutable per-cycle object naming; one trustworthy end-to-end integrity method for every cycle (server checksum, authenticated readback plus local hash comparison, or owner-approved equivalent); one authoritative bound (fixed count or 30 minutes), including in-progress-cycle timeout behavior; free-space floor and sampling cadence; exact margined rails/control points/tolerances/soak/restore; transfer timeout/retry policy, expected SEL/log behavior, cleanup and recovery approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Read-only BMC/storage baseline may occur now. After specification, operator establishes and independently verifies the signed margin. The authenticated client uploads the uniquely identified object, proves end-to-end integrity through the mandatory approved method, revalidates canonical containment, removes only that object, proves absence and records free space every cycle. Execute only the selected finite bound; do not choose between count and time at runtime.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Sandbox/privilege scope and canonical containment are proven, OOB remains reachable, continuous environment and per-cycle capacity monitoring are ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Firmware/interface/partition identity; canonical sandbox and per-cycle object identity/name/size/hash; chosen loop rule and boundary behavior; exact per-cycle upload/integrity/containment/delete/absence results and timestamps; per-cycle free space plus minimum observed reserve; completed count or full duration; continuous temperature and named-rail traces with tolerances; BMC services/sensors/SEL/network; final capacity, no residual object and nominal restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Every cycle required by the selected bound completes with matching integrity and exact cleanup, measured reserve never crosses its floor, signed environmental tolerances hold continuously, and BMC services/SEL meet owner criteria.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not browse/write arbitrary BMC paths, follow symlink/path traversal outside the sandbox, upload firmware/config/secret data, clear SEL, select or change the loop rule, retry automatically, run unboundedly or delete by wildcard/uncertain identity.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: BMC owner supplies sandbox/object/bound method; lab operator controls named physical rails, temperature and recovery.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Environment is manual; the owner-defined bounded transfer loop can be automated only through the approved interface.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop new transfers, preserve the failed exact object/evidence, restore named rails/temperature by the signed sequence, use supported cleanup/service recovery and never delete an uncertain path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Unresolved canonical target/method/bound/margin, unavailable or failed trustworthy end-to-end integrity method, containment failure, capacity floor breach, integrity or deletion failure, BMC service loss, SEL/storage/power/thermal anomaly, fixture drift or monitoring gap.

identified_defects: No file identity/integrity or loop bound.
Delete step could affect privileged storage.
reason_for_change: The semantic gaps block today's write operation, but they are owner-supplied parameters; the stable classification should reflect mandatory physical margin handling rather than describe inputs as permanent impossibility.
removed_ambiguities: Only a named sandbox object is writable/deletable.
remaining_blockers: Transfer recipe and sandbox remain unspecified.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains the hard no-write gate while replacing an over-BLOCKED capability label with MANUAL ONLY and adds object-level integrity, storage-reserve and exact-delete safeguards absent from V2.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Initial validator exposed bound, containment, reserve, margin and integrity-proof gaps. After two revisions, revalidation confirmed one authoritative finite bound, canonical containment, exact deletion, per-cycle reserve, named rail controls and mandatory end-to-end integrity for every cycle.
